test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks of the given series will complete the letter series.

P Q _ _T_ _ R S T P_ R _ T _ Q _ S T

options.text: S R P Q Q S R P
S R P Q Q S P R
R S P Q Q S P R
R S P Q S Q R P

solution:
Given Sequence: P Q _ _T_ _ R S T P_ R _ T _ Q _ S T

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one,

Option 1) S R P Q Q S R P → P Q __S__ __R__ T / __P__ __Q__ R S T / P __Q__ R __S__ T / __R__ Q __P__ S T

Option 2) S R P Q Q S P R → P Q __S__ __R__ T / __P__ <
